item.title: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank: the situation
item.description:
Israeli forces intensified a crackdown in Hebron, displacing thousands and prompting a UN warning of ethnic cleansing. Israeli raids across the West Bank injured Palestinians and led to arrests, while settlers assaulted activists and journalists in the occupied territory. Israel banned travel for Brad Lander after his detention in the West Bank and Jewish Israeli blocs rejected Palestinian support. In Gaza, Israeli strikes this week killed 21 people, an aid group reported worsening food insecurity as operations were sharply cut, and 21,440 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.
